notes.title: Continue your Brain Punk Adventure after the Free Weekend!
notes.content:
Attention All Cadets! SCARLET NEXUS is free to play this weekend on Steam!

Begin your adventure and explore vast areas in the Brain Punk futuristic world of New Himuka, to keep humanity safe from brain-craving deranged mutants!

With your unique psycho-kinetic abilities, the world around you becomes your greatest weapon! By using the SAS, you even get access to other powers such as Pyrokinesis, Teleportation, Invisibility and many more.

Featuring a dual protagonist story, choose the perspective of Yuito Sumeragi, an energetic recruit or Kasane Randall, the mysterious scout. 
Dive into a complex story of bonds, courage and heroism, crafted by minds behind the iconic Tales of Vesperia.

SCARLET NEXUS is playable for free from January, 26th 10AM PST/7PM CET to January, 30th 10AM PST/7PM CET.
Your saved data will be accessible when you purchase the full game after the Free Play period.

SCARLET NEXUS’ Standard and Ultimate Editions will be 75% off until Feb 3.

The Other Suppression Force needs you!

notes.title: Accessing… 📁 『Story Demo』
notes.content:
A new demo version Story Demo has been released, allowing players to experience the introductory section of the critically-acclaimed story from the point of view of the dual protagonists, Yuito Sumeragi and Kasane Randall.

Players can play through to Phase 2 of the story from the full game. Save data from the Story Demo can then be carried across to the full retail version, allowing you to pick up where you left off and also unlock special bonus content as well.

Some elements in Story Demo are restricted, and differ slightly from the full retail version. Additionally, since the bonus content is the same as content unlocked from carrying save data from Demo Edition, players who have already acquired this content will not be eligible to acquire it for a second time.


For the Steam® version, the Demo Edition and the Story Demo are available as a single download. Either can be selected at startup, and both are available to be played.
The items obtainable as bonus content can also be obtained in the full retail version by making your way through the story.

The free-to-play Story Demo is highly recommended for anyone who has yet to give SCARLET NEXUS a try!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/775500/SCARLET_NEXUS/

notes.title: 『New Paid DLC Pack 3 Deployed!』
notes.content:
The “Brain Eater Pack”, 3rd and final DLC of the Season Pass, adds more story content with Episode Karen: Unknown History. Taking place in 1996 in the SCARLET NEXUS’ world, players can witness the lost history of Karen Travers through 4 cutscene episodes unlocked by overcoming challenges. Recall a lost history, that no one but Karen himself knows, from his own perspective.

Among these challenges, the player will have to face a new enemy in the Vision Simulator, introduced in the last update. It is advised to finish both campaigns before taking on this DLC, as the episodes contain spoilers, revealing his true motive.

[previewyoutube=6uWmcVclKa8;full][/previewyoutube]
Players will be able to access 2 newly designed costume sets: 

the "Guardian Attire Set" based on Karen’s outfit by concept artist Tamami Ishikawa. Enjoy the majestic and dignified piano-black themed costumes, specially designed for the best psionics out there.
the "Heir Attire Set" by Masakazu Yamashiro, designer of the monsters roaming New Himuka, incorporated with the themes of ancient ethnic costumes in SCARLET NEXUS' world.

Also incorporated in the 3rd DLC, is a new plugin “Status Aliment Resister” directly unlockable from the shop, adding a twist to your next battles.

The incredibly powerful enemy, “Shadow of the Recording“, is appearing in a new mission in the Vision Simulator! Will you stand a chance against him as he makes an onslaught on you with unfair attacks you've never seen before...? Get rare attachments by scoring an S rank in the mission!
To defeat this enemy, it is essential to improve your stats by leveling up, unlocking new actions by increasing the bond level, and increasing the powers of your party members by obtaining powerful weapons and plug-ins.

The Other Suppression Force needs you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590567/SCARLET_NEXUS__Brain_Eater_Pack/

notes.title: 『Patch Update Ver.1.07』
notes.content:
You Asked, And We Heard!
In this free update, several highly-requested elements from SCARLET NEXUS fans are added into the game.

The New Photo Mode
Play around with the whole-new "Photo Mode" to capture the best moments in the game! Multiple camera options are made available, allowing you to take your favorite photos at the convenience of a button press, any time while exploring the world of SCARLET NEXUS.
You can capture and save photos not only during gameplay, but also at your favorite moments during cutscenes.

"Very Hard" Difficulty and New Challenges
For those who want more challenging gameplay, set the game's difficulty to the new "Very Hard" mode and face-off enemies with even more powerful attacks.
On top of that, for those who are in search of an ultimate challenge, try out the new Challenge missions and get extremely rare rewards, only if you can…

Equipable Support Plug-ins
For players who feel like the game is still too hard even in “Easy” difficulty, and those who would like to experience the story without all the effort with defeating strong enemies, we have added new plug-ins to support your journey in SCARLET NEXUS! Just update your game and obtain the plug-ins immediately in Shop for free!

New Collaboration Item
In commemoration of the release of the Chapter 1 Blu-Ray Disc Set in Japan for the SCARLET NEUXS anime series, the designed package and discs are added into the game as a new present!

notes.title: 『New Paid DLC Pack 2 and free update 1.05 Deployed!』
notes.content:
The “Bond Enhancement Pack 2” DLC brings 10 new bond episodes to the game unlocking the super-state “Nexus Drive” to upgrade SAS abilities. Each character’s SAS will gain new effects the player will have to master, adding complexity to the game’s combat, such as attack ranges and SAS gauge recovery or consumption speed.

[previewyoutube=AtD9b0dFhrI;full][/previewyoutube]
Players can showcase their newly acquired skills all over New Himuka wearing the stylish collaboration with artist Daisuke Richard, offering a new fresh set of costumes and weapons, the “Youth Attire” set.
In addition to the new DLC, a free upgrade brings a new feature called “Vision Simulator” allowing the player to rematch bosses fought in the main story and challenge missions with an adjustable difficulty level. Difficulty will include “Beginner”, “Novice” and “Master”. The highest difficulty, “Master”, will provide a more challenging and engaging experience to test the players skills after completing the main story.

4 new Others variations are added to the game, each with a unique added traits the players will have to understand, counter and defeat. The shop will welcome new challenges, costumes, and items via the free upgrade.

The Other Suppression Force needs you!

notes.title: Regarding supported controllers
notes.content:
We have received inquiries from our customers regarding controller compatibility.
Currently, the Steam ver. for SCARLET NEXUS is guaranteed to only work with the following controllers.
- Xbox Wireless Controller
- DualShock 4 Wireless Controller

If the button icons displayed in-game are different from those of your compatible controller, please try the following setting changes.

1) Access your Steam Library, right click on "SCARLET NEXUS" and select "Properties..."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110298/a9c1fa954c241104e632ddb776295bac5809dfd8.png

2) In the "CONTROLLER" tab, use drop-down menu to change override settings to "Disable Steam Input".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110298/cad8ad21103d2d834423152fac115bfa6dfa3b0d.png

Thank you for your continuous support.

notes.title: 『Retrieving records…』 📁 Two Protagonists
notes.content:
SCARLET NEXUS is told from two different perspectives through new OSF recruits, and you can choose to start as either. The truth of events will be revealed as you experience both perspectives.

[Yuito Sumeragi]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110298/59e1cbab02dc3ba75e48a0c6e7341f17bfbadbea.png
Yuito, an optimistic, cheerful young man with a kind, unbreakable spirit. He is the younger son of the renowned Sumeragi family, a name that boasts ties to the founding father of New Himuka. His father is leader of the country, while his older brother is the chairman and leader of the OSF.
Saved by a member of the OSF when he was young, his dream has been to join their forces to also save other people in need.
He treasures an ear cuff that he received when he was saved.

[Kasane Randall]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110298/775d9030b1b22c8f76c19e1268566a457dd55f25.png
Cool and logical, Kasane is brusque with others. The OSF recruited her for her combat sense and powers, and she graduated valedictorian. Though hard to approach, she shows kindness to those close to her.
Kasane was adopted by the Randalls after losing her parents in an Other attack. Kasane did not get along with her foster parents, but loves her foster sister, Naomi. A hand-made hairclip from Naomi is her most prized possession.
Kasane dreams of Red Strings, but no one knows what the images mean.
